title: Circumference and Area of a Circle — Areas Related to Circles
hook: Let's explore Circumference and Area of a Circle from the chapter on Areas Related to Circles. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Circumference and Area of a Circle Circumference = 2πr, Area = πr². These fundamental formulas are the building blocks for sector and segment calculations. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Circumference (perimeter) = 2πr = πd
💡 Area = πr²
💡 π ≈ 22/7 or 3.14159...
💡 Area of ring (annulus) = π(R² − r²) where R > r
